description: This file contains unit tests for the CLI module of the openbb project. It mocks command-line arguments and external functions to verify the behavior of the main CLI function under different argument scenarios.

methods.name: test_main_with_dev_and_debug(mock_launch, mock_bootstrap)
methods.description: Tests the main function with --dev and --debug flags enabled, verifying that bootstrap setup and the launch function are called with True, True.

methods.name: test_main_without_arguments(mock_launch, mock_bootstrap)
methods.description: Tests the main function with default arguments, verifying that bootstrap setup and the launch function are called with False, False.

methods.name: test_main_with_dev_only(mock_launch, mock_bootstrap)
methods.description: Tests the main function with only --dev flag, verifying appropriate calls with True, False.

methods.name: test_main_with_debug_only(mock_launch, mock_bootstrap)
methods.description: Tests the main function with only --debug flag, verifying appropriate calls with False, True.
